youtube.title: AI Receptionist for Home Service Business: After Hours Only (HVAC, Plumbing, Roofing)
youtube.description:
AI receptionist for home service business: HVAC, plumbing and roofing owners, run it after hours.
Only 36% of 782 homeowners were comfortable with AI scheduling appointments or answering basic questions (homeowner survey fielded Apr 24 to May 19, 2026 for BNP Media, published by ACHR News, Oct 20, 2026). On Jobber's owner forum, one owner who runs an AI receptionist after hours says hardly anyone stays on the call once they hear it's AI, and still keeps it on at night as a better voicemail. Jobber's own help page encourages telling callers the phone is answered by AI.

The setup:
1. Have your phone company forward calls to it only after hours.
2. Write a greeting that says it's AI.
3. Call it tonight like a customer with no heat, and listen.

At night the robot only has to beat a beep. Send this to whoever answers your phone after hours.
Next lesson: another owner problem from the trade forums, told start to finish.
What a missed call costs your shop, free: https://proofnotfluff.com/missed-call-cost-calculator/
